how_to: Phone alerts: the hourly update checks these rules and sends a notification when a good window is coming.
1. Install the free ntfy app (iPhone or Android) and subscribe to a topic name that's hard to guess, e.g. la-fishing-7xq2k9. Anyone who knows the name can read it.
2. In GitHub: Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > New repository secret. Name: NTFY_TOPIC. Value: your topic name.
3. Add rules below and set enabled to true. On the site, 'Get alerts for this' on any spot gives you a ready-made rule.
species: redfish, trout, flounder, sheepshead, drum, crab, bass, crappie, catfish, yft, mahi, wahoo, snapper, amberjack, kingmack, cobia, tripletail, mangrove, cubera
spots: spot ids from the site's link (#trout/barat means spot barat), or ["*"] for every spot.
min_score: alert when the best 3-hour daylight window in the next 48 hours averages at least this.
days: only windows starting on these days (Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun). Leave out for any day.
You get at most one alert per rule, spot and day.
